package com.synexia.primitives;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Generic struct-of-arrays primitive row store.
 *
 * <p>Every logical row uses the same physical index in every primitive lane and
 * in the optional metadata lanes. Insert/remove/swap/reorder operations move all
 * lanes together inside one synchronized mutation. There is no row object.
 */
public final class PrimitiveSoaStore {
    public static final int STATE_BYTES = 1;
    public static final int ROW_IDS = 1 << 1;
    public static final int VERSION_LONGS = 1 << 2;

    private final PrimitiveKind[] laneKinds;
    private final int metadataMask;
    private Object[] lanes;
    private byte[] states;
    private int[] rowIds;
    private long[] versions;
    private int size;
    private int nextRowId;
    private volatile long version;

    public PrimitiveSoaStore(PrimitiveKind... laneKinds) {
        this(8, 0, laneKinds);
    }

    public PrimitiveSoaStore(int initialCapacity, int metadataMask, PrimitiveKind... laneKinds) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(laneKinds, "laneKinds");
        if (laneKinds.length == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("at least one lane required");
        if (initialCapacity < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("initialCapacity < 0");
        int supported = STATE_BYTES | ROW_IDS | VERSION_LONGS;
        if ((metadataMask & ~supported) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown metadata bit");
        this.laneKinds = Arrays.copyOf(laneKinds, laneKinds.length);
        this.metadataMask = metadataMask;

        int capacity = Math.max(1, initialCapacity);
        lanes = new Object[laneKinds.length];
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            PrimitiveKind kind = Objects.requireNonNull(laneKinds[lane], "lane kind");
            lanes[lane] = kind.newArray(capacity);
        }
        if (hasMetadata(STATE_BYTES)) states = new byte[capacity];
        if (hasMetadata(ROW_IDS)) rowIds = new int[capacity];
        if (hasMetadata(VERSION_LONGS)) versions = new long[capacity];
    }

    public int laneCount() { return laneKinds.length; }
    public PrimitiveKind laneKind(int lane) { return laneKinds[checkLane(lane)]; }
    public int metadataMask() { return metadataMask; }
    public synchronized int size() { return size; }
    public synchronized boolean isEmpty() { return size == 0; }
    public synchronized int capacity() { return java.lang.reflect.Array.getLength(lanes[0]); }
    public long version() { return version; }

    public synchronized long payloadBytes() {
        long bytes = 0L;
        int capacity = capacity();
        for (PrimitiveKind kind : laneKinds) bytes += kind.payloadBytes(capacity);
        if (states != null) bytes += states.length;
        if (rowIds != null) bytes += (long) rowIds.length * Integer.BYTES;
        if (versions != null) bytes += (long) versions.length * Long.BYTES;
        return bytes;
    }

    public synchronized int appendRow(long[] rowBits) {
        return insertRow(size, rowBits, (byte) 0, 0L);
    }

    public synchronized int appendRow(long[] rowBits, byte state, long rowVersion) {
        return insertRow(size, rowBits, state, rowVersion);
    }

    public synchronized int append1(long valueBits) {
        requireLaneCount(1);
        checkRowIdAvailable();
        ensureCapacityInternal(size + 1);
        int row = size;
        laneKinds[0].writeBits(lanes[0], row, valueBits);
        initializeMetadata(row, (byte) 0, 0L);
        size++;
        version++;
        return row;
    }

    public synchronized int append2(long firstBits, long secondBits) {
        return append2(firstBits, secondBits, (byte) 0, 0L);
    }

    public synchronized int append2(
            long firstBits, long secondBits, byte state, long rowVersion) {
        requireLaneCount(2);
        checkRowIdAvailable();
        ensureCapacityInternal(size + 1);
        int row = size;
        laneKinds[0].writeBits(lanes[0], row, firstBits);
        laneKinds[1].writeBits(lanes[1], row, secondBits);
        initializeMetadata(row, state, rowVersion);
        size++;
        version++;
        return row;
    }

    public synchronized int insertRow(
            int index, long[] rowBits, byte state, long rowVersion) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(rowBits, "rowBits");
        if (rowBits.length != laneKinds.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("lane count mismatch");
        checkInsertIndex(index);
        checkRowIdAvailable();
        ensureCapacityInternal(size + 1);
        openRow(index);
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            laneKinds[lane].writeBits(lanes[lane], index, rowBits[lane]);
        }
        initializeMetadata(index, state, rowVersion);
        size++;
        version++;
        return index;
    }

    public synchronized int insert2(
            int index, long firstBits, long secondBits, byte state, long rowVersion) {
        requireLaneCount(2);
        checkInsertIndex(index);
        checkRowIdAvailable();
        ensureCapacityInternal(size + 1);
        openRow(index);
        laneKinds[0].writeBits(lanes[0], index, firstBits);
        laneKinds[1].writeBits(lanes[1], index, secondBits);
        initializeMetadata(index, state, rowVersion);
        size++;
        version++;
        return index;
    }

    public synchronized long getBits(int lane, int row) {
        return laneKinds[checkLane(lane)].readBits(lanes[lane], checkRow(row));
    }

    public synchronized void readRow(int row, long[] target) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(target, "target");
        if (target.length < laneKinds.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("target too small");
        int checked = checkRow(row);
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            target[lane] = laneKinds[lane].readBits(lanes[lane], checked);
        }
    }

    public synchronized void setBits(int lane, int row, long bits) {
        int checkedLane = checkLane(lane);
        int checkedRow = checkRow(row);
        laneKinds[checkedLane].writeBits(lanes[checkedLane], checkedRow, bits);
        version++;
    }

    public synchronized void setRow(int row, long[] rowBits) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(rowBits, "rowBits");
        if (rowBits.length != laneKinds.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("lane count mismatch");
        int checked = checkRow(row);
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            laneKinds[lane].writeBits(lanes[lane], checked, rowBits[lane]);
        }
        version++;
    }

    public synchronized byte stateAt(int row) {
        requireMetadata(STATE_BYTES);
        return states[checkRow(row)];
    }

    public synchronized void stateAt(int row, byte state) {
        requireMetadata(STATE_BYTES);
        states[checkRow(row)] = state;
        version++;
    }

    public synchronized int rowIdAt(int row) {
        requireMetadata(ROW_IDS);
        return rowIds[checkRow(row)];
    }

    public synchronized long rowVersionAt(int row) {
        requireMetadata(VERSION_LONGS);
        return versions[checkRow(row)];
    }

    public synchronized void rowVersionAt(int row, long rowVersion) {
        requireMetadata(VERSION_LONGS);
        versions[checkRow(row)] = rowVersion;
        version++;
    }

    /** Removes a row by shifting the complete suffix in every lane together. */
    public synchronized void removeAt(int index) {
        int row = checkRow(index);
        int moved = size - row - 1;
        if (moved > 0) {
            for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
                System.arraycopy(lanes[lane], row + 1, lanes[lane], row, moved);
            }
            if (states != null) System.arraycopy(states, row + 1, states, row, moved);
            if (rowIds != null) System.arraycopy(rowIds, row + 1, rowIds, row, moved);
            if (versions != null) System.arraycopy(versions, row + 1, versions, row, moved);
        }
        clearRow(size - 1);
        size--;
        version++;
    }

    /** Removes one contiguous row range with one coordinated shift per lane. */
    public synchronized void removeRange(int fromInclusive, int toExclusive) {
        if (fromInclusive < 0 || toExclusive < fromInclusive || toExclusive > size) {
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
        }
        int removed = toExclusive - fromInclusive;
        if (removed == 0) return;
        int moved = size - toExclusive;
        if (moved > 0) {
            for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
                System.arraycopy(lanes[lane], toExclusive, lanes[lane], fromInclusive, moved);
            }
            if (states != null) System.arraycopy(states, toExclusive, states, fromInclusive, moved);
            if (rowIds != null) System.arraycopy(rowIds, toExclusive, rowIds, fromInclusive, moved);
            if (versions != null) System.arraycopy(versions, toExclusive, versions, fromInclusive, moved);
        }
        int newSize = size - removed;
        for (int row = newSize; row < size; row++) clearRow(row);
        size = newSize;
        version++;
    }

    /** O(1) unordered removal: moves the last complete row into the removed slot. */
    public synchronized void removeSwap(int index) {
        int row = checkRow(index);
        int last = size - 1;
        if (row != last) copyRowRaw(last, row);
        clearRow(last);
        size--;
        version++;
    }

    /** Swaps one complete logical row across every data and metadata lane. */
    public synchronized void swapRows(int left, int right) {
        int a = checkRow(left);
        int b = checkRow(right);
        if (a == b) return;
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            PrimitiveKind kind = laneKinds[lane];
            long temp = kind.readBits(lanes[lane], a);
            kind.writeBits(lanes[lane], a, kind.readBits(lanes[lane], b));
            kind.writeBits(lanes[lane], b, temp);
        }
        if (states != null) {
            byte temp = states[a];
            states[a] = states[b];
            states[b] = temp;
        }
        if (rowIds != null) {
            int temp = rowIds[a];
            rowIds[a] = rowIds[b];
            rowIds[b] = temp;
        }
        if (versions != null) {
            long temp = versions[a];
            versions[a] = versions[b];
            versions[b] = temp;
        }
        version++;
    }

    /**
     * Reorders the whole store from source-row indexes.
     *
     * <p>All replacement arrays are fully built first and then published together,
     * so an allocation/validation failure leaves the current store unchanged.
     */
    public synchronized void reorder(int[] sourceRows) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(sourceRows, "sourceRows");
        if (sourceRows.length != size) throw new IllegalArgumentException("not a full permutation");
        byte[] seen = new byte[size];
        for (int row : sourceRows) {
            if (row < 0 || row >= size || seen[row] != 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid permutation");
            }
            seen[row] = 1;
        }

        Object[] nextLanes = new Object[laneKinds.length];
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            nextLanes[lane] = laneKinds[lane].newArray(capacity());
            for (int target = 0; target < size; target++) {
                laneKinds[lane].writeBits(
                        nextLanes[lane], target,
                        laneKinds[lane].readBits(lanes[lane], sourceRows[target]));
            }
        }
        byte[] nextStates = states == null ? null : new byte[capacity()];
        int[] nextRowIds = rowIds == null ? null : new int[capacity()];
        long[] nextVersions = versions == null ? null : new long[capacity()];
        for (int target = 0; target < size; target++) {
            int source = sourceRows[target];
            if (nextStates != null) nextStates[target] = states[source];
            if (nextRowIds != null) nextRowIds[target] = rowIds[source];
            if (nextVersions != null) nextVersions[target] = versions[source];
        }

        lanes = nextLanes;
        states = nextStates;
        rowIds = nextRowIds;
        versions = nextVersions;
        version++;
    }

    /** Keeps rows whose state byte contains every bit in requiredMask. */
    public synchronized int retainStateMask(int requiredMask) {
        requireMetadata(STATE_BYTES);
        int write = 0;
        for (int read = 0; read < size; read++) {
            if ((states[read] & requiredMask) == requiredMask) {
                if (write != read) copyRowRaw(read, write);
                write++;
            }
        }
        int removed = size - write;
        for (int row = write; row < size; row++) clearRow(row);
        size = write;
        if (removed != 0) version++;
        return removed;
    }

    public synchronized PrimitiveSoaStore copyRows(int[] sourceRows) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(sourceRows, "sourceRows");
        PrimitiveSoaStore copy =
                new PrimitiveSoaStore(Math.max(1, sourceRows.length), metadataMask, laneKinds);
        for (int target = 0; target < sourceRows.length; target++) {
            int source = checkRow(sourceRows[target]);
            for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
                laneKinds[lane].writeBits(
                        copy.lanes[lane], target,
                        laneKinds[lane].readBits(lanes[lane], source));
            }
            if (states != null) copy.states[target] = states[source];
            if (rowIds != null) copy.rowIds[target] = rowIds[source];
            if (versions != null) copy.versions[target] = versions[source];
        }
        copy.size = sourceRows.length;
        copy.nextRowId = nextRowId;
        return copy;
    }

    public synchronized void ensureCapacity(int required) {
        if (required < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("required < 0");
        ensureCapacityInternal(required);
    }

    public synchronized void clear() {
        for (int row = 0; row < size; row++) clearRow(row);
        size = 0;
        version++;
    }

    private void openRow(int index) {
        int moved = size - index;
        if (moved == 0) return;
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            System.arraycopy(lanes[lane], index, lanes[lane], index + 1, moved);
        }
        if (states != null) System.arraycopy(states, index, states, index + 1, moved);
        if (rowIds != null) System.arraycopy(rowIds, index, rowIds, index + 1, moved);
        if (versions != null) System.arraycopy(versions, index, versions, index + 1, moved);
    }

    private void initializeMetadata(int row, byte state, long rowVersion) {
        if (states != null) states[row] = state;
        if (rowIds != null) rowIds[row] = nextRowId++;
        if (versions != null) versions[row] = rowVersion;
    }

    private void copyRowRaw(int source, int target) {
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            PrimitiveKind kind = laneKinds[lane];
            kind.writeBits(lanes[lane], target, kind.readBits(lanes[lane], source));
        }
        if (states != null) states[target] = states[source];
        if (rowIds != null) rowIds[target] = rowIds[source];
        if (versions != null) versions[target] = versions[source];
    }

    private void clearRow(int row) {
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            laneKinds[lane].clear(lanes[lane], row, row + 1);
        }
        if (states != null) states[row] = 0;
        if (rowIds != null) rowIds[row] = 0;
        if (versions != null) versions[row] = 0L;
    }

    private void ensureCapacityInternal(int required) {
        int current = capacity();
        if (required <= current) return;
        int next = current + (current >>> 1) + 1;
        if (next < required) next = required;

        Object[] nextLanes = new Object[laneKinds.length];
        for (int lane = 0; lane < laneKinds.length; lane++) {
            nextLanes[lane] = laneKinds[lane].copyOf(lanes[lane], next);
        }
        byte[] nextStates = states == null ? null : Arrays.copyOf(states, next);
        int[] nextRowIds = rowIds == null ? null : Arrays.copyOf(rowIds, next);
        long[] nextVersions = versions == null ? null : Arrays.copyOf(versions, next);

        lanes = nextLanes;
        states = nextStates;
        rowIds = nextRowIds;
        versions = nextVersions;
    }

    private void checkRowIdAvailable() {
        if (rowIds != null && nextRowId == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("row id exhausted");
        }
    }

    private boolean hasMetadata(int bit) {
        return (metadataMask & bit) != 0;
    }

    private void requireMetadata(int bit) {
        if (!hasMetadata(bit)) throw new IllegalStateException("metadata lane not enabled");
    }

    private void requireLaneCount(int expected) {
        if (laneKinds.length != expected) throw new IllegalStateException("expected " + expected + " lanes");
    }

    private int checkLane(int lane) {
        if (lane < 0 || lane >= laneKinds.length) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(lane);
        return lane;
    }

    private int checkRow(int row) {
        if (row < 0 || row >= size) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(row);
        return row;
    }

    private void checkInsertIndex(int row) {
        if (row < 0 || row > size) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException(row);
    }
}
